close_reason: Bikeshed signal: P4 + explicit 'opinion' label. The bead itself says 'Labeled opinion because some teams prefer the explicit match for searchability.' Per /do-beads convergence rule, P3+/opinion-labeled beads are not actionable in the review loop. The existing to_wire_str pattern is defensible (explicit, grep-able, compile-error if a variant is added without updating the match) and the proposed serde_json::to_string alternative is also defensible. Neither is wrong; consistency with the sibling TaskProgress could go either way. Closing without code action — the choice belongs to whoever next touches TaskListRole semantics.
title: TaskListRole::to_wire_str duplicates the impl_string_enum macro\'s Serialize impl
